what: Vespi on the zhol site: every file, where it came from, and for new poses the Higgsfield job and exact prompt (brand/MASCOT.md §4).
processing: trimmed transparent margins, fitted bottom-aligned into a 560x448 (5:4) canvas so steps do not jump; WebP q80, alpha q90; 560 (2x) and 280 (1x)

poses.name: truck
poses.prompt: The exact same handmade toy character as in the reference images (Vespi): almost smooth cream cotton body with fine fibers and a few loose seam threads, glossy satin red helmet with a cream center stripe and a small olive side button, tiny embroidered black dot eyes, small pink cheeks, quiet proud smile, olive-green felt cape collar with one red button. Full figure standing next to a small toy European truck with a plain cream box trailer, the truck about as tall as Vespi, one mitten hand resting on the truck cab, calm and proud. Soft daylight studio light, gentle contact shadow, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no letters, no logos, no license plates, no other characters.

poses.name: watch
poses.prompt: The exact same handmade toy character as in the reference images (Vespi): almost smooth cream cotton body with fine fibers and a few loose seam threads, glossy satin red helmet with a cream center stripe and a small olive side button, tiny embroidered black dot eyes, small pink cheeks, small thoughtful smile with thin slightly raised eyebrows, olive-green felt cape collar with one red button. Half-body, holding a round brass pocket watch with both mitten hands and looking down at it, keeping an eye on the time. The watch face shows only plain tick marks and two hands. Soft daylight studio light, gentle contact shadow, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no other characters.
